## 5-Minute Quick Start 🚀

This guide gets you contributing in 5 minutes. For detailed instructions, see the [Contributing Guide](contributing.qmd).

### 1. Fork & Clone (1 min)

```bash
# Fork on GitHub, then:
git clone git@github.com:YOUR_USERNAME/aBCI-OSS-example.git
cd aBCI-OSS-example
```

### 2. Setup Environment (2 min)

```bash
# Create and activate virtual environment
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate  # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -e ".[docs]"
```

### 3. Create Your Example (1 min)

```bash
# Create a branch
git checkout -b add-example-YOUR_NAME

# Start Jupyter
jupyter notebook docs/examples/
```

Create a notebook with:
- Title and introduction
- Code examples with explanations
- Visualizations or outputs
- Conclusion

### 4. Test Locally (30 sec)

```bash
# Build and preview
quarto preview
```

Check that your notebook appears and renders correctly.

### 5. Submit PR (30 sec)

```bash
# Commit and push
git add docs/examples/your_example.ipynb
git commit -m "docs: Add example on [YOUR TOPIC]"
git push origin add-example-YOUR_NAME
```

Go to https://github.com/bsdlab/aBCI-OSS-example and create a pull request!

## Example Notebook Structure

```markdown
# Title of Your Example

Brief description of what you'll demonstrate.

**Author:** Your Name
```

```python
# Import required libraries
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```markdown
## Section 1: Concept Explanation

Explain the concept you're teaching...
```

```python
# Demonstrate with code
data = np.random.randn(100)
plt.plot(data)
plt.title("Example Visualization")
plt.show()
```

```markdown
## Conclusion

Summarize what was learned...
```
